description: Questions the eval papers (BERT, Attention Is All You Need, GPT-3 Few-Shot, COVID smartwatch) do not answer. `kind` is off_topic (nothing to do with the papers) or in_domain (about the papers, but the answer is not in them). Used by eval/abstention_calibration.py. Written by hand on 2026-10-24; the in_domain ones were chosen to be absent, not verified line by line against every PDF.
